Consumer, retail and leisure organizations are under ever-evolving pressure: margins are tightening, customer behaviors are shifting, and the pace of AI-driven disruption is reshaping how brands connect, sell and grow. For those leading the charge, success is no longer just about agility: it’s about becoming masters of navigating change.

From helping accelerate digital transformation to strengthening supply chain resilience and reimagining the customer experience, we work across the entire consumer goods, retail and leisure sectors to drive sustainable growth built on data, purpose and loyalty.

Our consumer, retail and leisure network unites Audit, Tax and Advisory professionals from KPMG firms around the world to deliver connected, multidisciplinary support. Combining big-picture thinking with tailored transformation, we’re here to help you modernize, stay competitive and build experiences that make the difference.

Government & Public Sector

发布源: KPMG --Netherlands | 抓取时间: 2026-08-13

Agencies and jurisdictions, governments and public sector organizations are faced with a stifling mandate: delivering more to citizens amid tighter budgets, aging infrastructure and heightened expectations for transparency, security and digital access.

We work with these organizations to help close the gap between ambition and delivery; designing transformation strategies that help turn policy goals into real-world results. Whether optimizing funding models, modernizing public infrastructure, or harnessing the full potential of AI and technology to improve citizen experiences, we’re here to help you connect systems, people and purpose to enhance lasting public value.

Our global government and public sector network unites Audit, Tax and Advisory professionals from KPMG firms around the world to deliver coordinated, multidisciplinary approaches. With deep experience across public finance, infrastructure, health and human services, education and defense, we combine strategic insight with operational know-how to support governments and public sector organizations in delivering impact where it matters most: in the lives of the people they serve.

Delve deeper into how KPMG and Microsoft are helping modernize organizations to meet ever-evolving citizen expectations, through flexible cloud-based and mobile-first solutions.

item.content:encoded:
Energy, Natural Resources & Chemicals

发布源: KPMG --Netherlands | 抓取时间: 2026-08-13

Energy and resources companies are facing big challenges — from the global push for lower-carbon solutions to rising demand and market volatility. Geopolitical tensions, supply chain disruptions, and price swings complicate planning, while new regulations and public pressure raise the bar on emissions and social responsibility. Technology offers transformative potential, but integrating AI, automation, and digital platforms into legacy systems remains complex.

KPMG works with organizations across oil and gas, renewables, power and utilities, mining, and chemicals to navigate the energy transition and seize growth opportunities. Focused on practical strategies that enhance efficiency, accelerate digital adoption, and build resilience — helping organizations move confidently in a fast-changing market.

Our people combine deep sector knowledge with a multidisciplinary perspective, bringing together specialists to build strategies that balance sustainability, profitability, and energy security. Helping you use digital tools — like AI, IoT, and advanced data analytics — to enhance performance and speed up decision-making. Whether you're just starting out or scaling up, we focus on approaches that fit your business and help drive real value. With global reach and local insight, KPMG works side by side with organizations to turn complexity into opportunity — driving transformation that lasts.

Engaged research in The Hague

发布源: Institute of Social Studies --Netherlands | 抓取时间: 2026-08-13

Within the city, ISS is strategically positioned and has undertaken initiatives and research that support the position of The Hague as an international metropolis of peace, justice and security.

ISS has close links, teaching programmes and capacity building projects with many of the international organizations, ministries, embassies and NGOs in and around The Hague.

This collaborative project investigates the specific challenges faced by LGBTQ+ refugees and youth face and asks how exclusion at school can be reduced and awareness raised

ISS students participate in an individual and institutional capacity in many social and development initiatives by The Hague council.

item.description: 网站专栏报告。作者: 智库研究员。这篇智库文章初次发表在Institute of Social Studies --Netherlands官方网站上。
item.content:encoded:
Funding and scholarships

发布源: Institute of Social Studies --Netherlands | 抓取时间: 2026-08-13

Most students studying at ISS do so with a partial or full scholarship. To help you find appropriate funding for your studies, we have compiled all the available scholarships per-country and created a scholarship database. Selecting your country of origin, will generate a list of available funding opportunities.

Students with European Union Citizenship should be aware that the subsidies that the Dutch Government provides through a DUO loan for a study at a regular Dutch university do not apply to the study programmes at ISS, although the ISS MA programme is fully accredited.

EU students are highly encouraged to apply for either of the ISS partial scholarships stated above.
